title: Asiaticoside attenuates renal fibrosis by targeting STAT3 to restore Th17/Treg homeostasis.
authors: Xie, Li-Jun; Wei, Qing; Ni, Hai-Feng; Jiang, Wei; Ni, Wei-Jie; Wang, Bo; Fu, Yu-Qi; Chen, Si-Jie; Zhang, Yi-Lin; Yang, Qin; Wen, Yi; Tang, Tao-Tao; Lv, Lin-Li; Wang, Bin; Liu, Bi-Cheng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Asiaticoside通过靶向STAT3蛋白（非DNA）的SH2域并利用分子对接/动力学模拟揭示变构降解机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作建模，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Renal fibrosis (RF) is a progressive pathological process driven by chronic inflammation and Th17/Treg imbalance. Asiaticoside (AS), a triterpenoid compound from Centella asiatica (L.) Urb., exhibits anti-inflammatory and antifibrotic activities, though its molecular mechanism remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to investigate whether AS alleviates RF by targeting Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) through a "bind to destabilize" mechanism to restore Th17/Treg homeostasis. METHODS: An integrated approach combining network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and multimodal experimental validation was applied. UUO mice were treated with AS (10, 50, 100mg/kg/d) for 10 days. Histopathology, RNA‑seq, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, Luminex, qPCR, DARTS‑LC‑MS/MS, molecular docking/dynamics simulations and SPR were performed. Pharmacological interventions using Stattic (STAT3 inhibitor) and Colivelin (STAT3 agonist) were included to functionally validate the role of STAT3. RESULTS: Network pharmacology identified STAT3 as the core target, with Th17 differentiation as the key pathway. AS treatment significantly attenuated RF, improved renal function, and rebalanced Th17/Treg ratios in UUO mice, accompanied by reduced IL-17A and elevated IL-10. Transcriptomic analysis revealed enriched Th17 cell differentiation genes, validated by qPCR. DARTS-LC-MS/MS confirmed direct binding of AS to STAT3 and identified a peptide derived from the SH2 domain (residues 582-602), indicating conformational destabilization. SPR showed high affinity binding to both human and murine STAT3. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations demonstrated a "local anchoring-allosteric effect" mode within the SH2 domain. qPCR analysis showed that AS significantly inhibited the mRNA expression of both IL-17A and total STAT3 in the renal tissues of UUO mice. Immunofluorescence revealed reduced STAT3 and p-STAT3 expression in kidneys. STAT3 inhibitor Stattic mimicked AS's antifibrotic and Th17 suppressive effects, whereas agonist Colivelin exacerbated fibrosis and was partially rescued by AS. CONCLUSION: AS alleviates RF via a novel "bind to destabilize" allosteric degradation mechanism that directly targets the STAT3 SH2 domain. This interaction induces conformational instability, suppresses STAT3 activation and transcriptional activity, restores Th17/Treg homeostasis, and ultimately mitigates renal inflammation and fibrosis. Collectively, these findings establish a new therapeutic strategy for STAT3-driven fibrotic diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾纤维化（RF）是一种由慢性炎症和Th17/Treg失衡驱动的进行性病理过程。积雪草苷（AS）是从积雪草（Centella asiatica (L.) Urb.）中提取的三萜类化合物，具有抗炎和抗纤维化活性，但其分子机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨AS是否通过“结合致不稳定”机制靶向信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）以恢复Th17/Treg稳态，从而缓解RF。方法：采用网络药理学、转录组学和多模式实验验证相结合的综合方法。UUO小鼠接受AS（10、50、100 mg/kg/d）治疗10天。进行了组织病理学、RNA-seq、流式细胞术、免疫荧光、Luminex、qPCR、DARTS-LC-MS/MS、分子对接/动力学模拟和SPR分析。使用Stattic（STAT3抑制剂）和Colivelin（STAT3激动剂）进行药理学干预，以功能验证STAT3的作用。结果：网络药理学将STAT3确定为核心靶点，Th17分化为关键通路。AS治疗显著减轻了UUO小鼠的RF，改善了肾功能，并重新平衡了Th17/Treg比例，同时伴随IL-17A降低和IL-10升高。转录组学分析揭示了Th17细胞分化基因的富集，并通过qPCR验证。DARTS-LC-MS/MS确认了AS与STAT3的直接结合，并鉴定出源自SH2结构域（残基582-602）的肽段，表明构象不稳定化。SPR显示AS与人源和小鼠STAT3均具有高亲和力结合。分子对接和动力学模拟展示了SH2结构域内的“局部锚定-变构效应”模式。qPCR分析显示，AS显著抑制了UUO小鼠肾组织中IL-17A和总STAT3的mRNA表达。免疫荧光显示肾脏中STAT3和p-STAT3表达降低。STAT3抑制剂Stattic模拟了AS的抗纤维化和Th17抑制作用，而激动剂Colivelin加重了纤维化，且部分被AS挽救。结论：AS通过一种新颖的“结合致不稳定”变构降解机制缓解RF，该机制直接靶向STAT3 SH2结构域。这种相互作用诱导构象不稳定性，抑制STAT3激活和转录活性，恢复Th17/Treg稳态，并最终减轻肾脏炎症和纤维化。总之，这些发现为STAT3驱动的纤维化疾病建立了一种新的治疗策略。
